title: The Shinigami Checkmate Unfolds in Part 1

series.summary: L investigates the validity of the thirteen-day rule as Light forces the Shinigami Rem into an impossible sacrifice.

cuts.voiceover_text: A single torn piece of paper might expose the most dangerous killer in history. L sits in task force headquarters carefully examining the captured Death Note. He spots a missing corner and immediately grills the Shinigami Rem. If a torn scrap can still kill, every past alibi is useless. Rem claims ignorance, but L’s suspicion is already ignited.

Meanwhile, outside the building, Light Yagami pulls Misa aside for a brief private exchange. He explains that non-stop surveillance prevents him from punishing criminals himself. Light orders Misa to resume the killings using her hidden notebook. Misa eagerly agrees to build their new world, completely blind to the fact that she is walking into his trap.

Soon after, the headquarters monitors light up with breaking news of sixteen sudden criminal deaths. Every single execution took place right after Higuchi died. The detectives freeze in sheer disbelief as Kira’s judgment violently restarts. L watches the screens in tense silence, certain that Misa’s release and this fresh wave of murders are directly connected.

L crouches barefoot in his chair, relentlessly picking apart the rules written inside the Death Note. If a torn piece of paper can kill, only one single detail is keeping Light and Misa innocent. The notebook states that anyone who writes a name must write another within thirteen days or perish. Because both suspects survived fifty days of confinement, that rule cleared them completely. But if that thirteen-day rule is a lie, Light is Kira.

Listening from the shadows, the Shinigami Rem suddenly grasps the terrifying genius behind Light’s trap. Light purposefully forced Misa to resume killing so L would corner her and demand the death penalty. To save Misa from execution, Rem has no choice but to write L’s true name in the Death Note. But using divine power to prolong a human life will turn Rem into dust. Light has orchestrated an inescapable checkmate that forces the Shinigami to sacrifice herself just to eliminate L.

Suddenly, blazing red warning screens trigger as Watari wipes all investigation data before collapsing. Emergency sirens scream through the room while the task force panics in absolute confusion. L jolts from his chair and scans the room, realizing in horror that the Shinigami Rem has vanished into thin air. Light’s lethal trap has been sprung, leaving L with nowhere left to run.
